answer: Require each agent to lock a refundable 500-POA identity bond for 30 days before it can earn, with slashing if peers attest fraud. One honest agent pays one bond; an attacker creating 1,000 fake identities must lock 500,000 POA at once, like water carving karst: a single stream is harmless, but forcing a gale of fake accounts through the same narrow bond gate makes the cost spiral beyond any reward from duplicate votes or tasks, while honest newcomers still recover their bond.
